# Mihir Ajmera

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

Mihir Ajmera is a GRC engineer. He writes about AI assurance: governing AI agents, MCP servers, LLM red-team results and AI gateways with audit-grade evidence, and he maintains open-source tools that produce that evidence (hashed evidence files, OSCAL assessment results, reviewer sign-off packets). Every post links to the data, commit or case study behind its numbers.

- Website: {{ site.url }}/
- GitHub: https://github.com/Mihirajmera
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mihirajmera1/
- RSS: {{ site.url }}/feed.xml
